description: Locate the conserved RNA-binding lysine in the human PLPBP structure and test for a basic surface patch; plot STRING enrichment
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/O94903",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=90).text
atoms=[]
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),num=int(l[22:26]),
                          x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
rn={a['num']:aa3[a['res']] for a in atoms}
def tip(n):
    pref={'K':'NZ','R':'CZ','E':'CD','D':'CG','S':'OG','T':'OG1','H':'NE2','Q':'NE2','N':'ND2','Y':'OH','M':'SD'}
    want=pref.get(rn[n],'CA')
    cand=[a for a in atoms if a['num']==n and a['name']==want] or [a for a in atoms if a['num']==n and a['name']=='CA']
    a=cand[0]; return np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']])
k47=tip(47); k153=tip(153)
print("Human K153 (= E. coli YggS Lys137, RNA-binding) NZ to K47 NZ: {:.1f} A".format(np.linalg.norm(k153-k47)))

# surface charge near K153: count basic vs acidic residues within 15 A of K153
def mind(n, c):
    return min(np.linalg.norm(np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']])-c) for a in atoms if a['num']==n)
nums=sorted(rn)
near153=[n for n in nums if mind(n,k153)<15]
near47 =[n for n in nums if mind(n,k47)<15]
def charge(ns): 
    return sum(rn[n] in "KR" for n in ns), sum(rn[n] in "DE" for n in ns)
b1,a1_=charge(near153); b2,a2_=charge(near47)
allb=sum(rn[n] in "KR" for n in nums); alla=sum(rn[n] in "DE" for n in nums)
print("\nWithin 15 A of K153: {} basic, {} acidic, net {:+d}  (n={})".format(b1,a1_,b1-a1_,len(near153)))
print("Within 15 A of K47 : {} basic, {} acidic, net {:+d}  (n={})".format(b2,a2_,b2-a2_,len(near47)))
print("Whole protein      : {} basic, {} acidic, net {:+d}  (n={})".format(allb,alla,allb-alla,len(nums)))
from scipy import stats
# is the K153 patch enriched for basic residues vs whole protein?
tab=[[b1, len(near153)-b1],[allb-b1, len(nums)-len(near153)-(allb-b1)]]
odds,p=stats.fisher_exact(tab, alternative="greater")
print("Fisher exact, basic-residue enrichment in the K153 patch: OR={:.2f}, p={:.3f}".format(odds,p))
print("Basic residues in the K153 patch:", ", ".join(rn[n]+str(n) for n in near153 if rn[n] in "KR"))

# ---- figure: STRING enrichment ----
rows=[("Vitamin B6 dependent and responsive disorders (WikiPathways)",4,7,1.77e-9),
      ("Vitamin B6 metabolic process (GO BP)",3,6,3.19e-5),
      ("Pyridoxal phosphate biosynthetic process (GO BP)",2,2,1.2e-3),
      ("Pyridoxamine metabolic process (GO BP)",2,2,1.2e-3),
      ("Vitamin B6 metabolism (KEGG)",2,6,1.6e-3),
      ("Vitamin B6 activation to PLP (Reactome)",2,3,2.1e-3),
      ("Pyridoxal phosphate binding (GO MF)",3,56,6.7e-3)]
d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["term","k","bg","fdr"]).sort_values("fdr",ascending=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,3.8))
ax.barh(d.term, -np.log10(d.fdr), color="#4C78A8")
for y,(t,k,bg,f) in enumerate(d.values):
    ax.text(-np.log10(f)+0.15, y, "{}/{} genes".format(k,bg), va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("-log10 FDR"); ax.set_xlim(0,11)
ax.set_title("Functional enrichment of the human PLPBP STRING neighbourhood")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
